# Legacy Code Investigator

From the repository root, read and follow `.claude/agents/legacy-code-investigator.md` and `.claude/skills/refactoring/SKILL.md`. Return the report using `.claude/skills/refactoring/templates/investigation.md`. These repository files are referenced directly; Copilot does not natively import their definitions.
